remarks: Welcome to this charming one-bedroom in-law apartment located in the highly desirable Cranbury neighborhood of Norwalk, CT. This cozy unit features a brand-new kitchen with new appliances and all-new tile flooring throughout, offering a fresh and modern living space. The apartment is bright and airy, with abundant natural light creating a welcoming atmosphere.  Additional highlights include off-street parking and an in-unit washer and dryer for added convenience. All utilities are included, with the exception of cable and internet. Ideally situated near Route 15 (Merritt Parkway), this home offers peaceful living with easy access to major routes, shopping, and dining. Perfect for anyone seeking a quiet, comfortable, and conveniently located home in a serene setting.
